name: Absolute Bagels
closed_reason: Shut by the city Health Department after a December 2024 inspection found rats and roaches; the original owners did not return. Unaffiliated new owners opened 'New Absolute Bagels' (now listed as 2788 Bagels) in the space in Dec 2025.

name: Barbetta
closed_reason: Closed after 120 years following the death of longtime owner Laura Maioglio in January 2026 (founded 1906).

name: Jing Fong (Upper West Side)
closed_reason: Branch closed after eight years; no reason given. The Chinatown restaurant at 202 Centre St stays open.

name: Donohue's Steak House
closed_reason: Family-run steakhouse closed after 76 years; reason not stated.

name: Cozy Soup 'n' Burger
closed_reason: Closed after 54+ years, citing rising operating costs and slower business.

name: Craft
closed_reason: Tom Colicchio's restaurant closed after nearly 25 years; reason not disclosed.

name: The Leopard at des Artistes
closed_reason: Closed after about 15 years; reason not specified.

name: Red Bamboo
closed_reason: Vegan restaurant closed after about 24 years, citing financial strain.

name: Tin Building by Jean-Georges
closed_reason: Food hall closed after 3 years; the space is being turned over to a Balloon Museum.

name: Francesco's Pizza
closed_reason: 27-year Upper West Side pizzeria appears permanently closed: gate down, phone unanswered, interior gutted and a worker said yes when asked if it closed. Not yet confirmed by the owner.
